name: Open Exchange
description: Swap Mandala tokens against the pools on this exchange, and deploy and close liquidity positions.

groupPermissions.description: Open Exchange reads your tokens, builds swaps and pools with your wallet, and receives the sats pools pay you.

spendingAuthorization.description: Up to 0.1 BSV a month for swap inputs, pool deposits and network fees.

protocolPermissions.description: Derive the keys that hold your tokens and pools (1Sat token keys).
Derive one-time keys for the sats pools pay you, and for your LP position (BRC-29 payments to yourself).
Show which wallet is connected and name it as the sender of payments to yourself.
Create and check the session nonces of authenticated requests to the overlay instance.
Sign authenticated requests to the overlay instance (asked once per instance, on first use).
Label the swaps you build, their funding and their payouts so they are listed together in your wallet.
Label the pools you create so they are listed together in your wallet.
Label the positions you close so they are listed together in your wallet.
Label the pool payouts your wallet takes in so they are listed together.

basketAccess.description: Read and file your tokens and the pools you hold as LP.
Read your ordinals to offer them as token icons, and file a new icon you inscribe.
File the exact funding output of each swap under a short hold, and drop it once the swap has spent it.
